senses.gloss: treading, place trodden upon, in gen. basis, seat, esp. midras, levitical uncleanness arising from a gonorrhoeist’s immediate contact by treading, leaning against &c.
units: Nidd. VI, 3 כל המיטמא (ב)מ׳ whatever can be made unclean as a midras; expl.
<cite ref="Niddah 49b:18">ib. 49ᵇ</cite> <he>כל דחזי למ׳</he> whatever is fit to be used as a seat, couch &c.
Par. X, 1; a. v. fr.—In gen. = אב הטומאה, uncleanness of the first degree.
Ḥag. II, 7; a. fr.—Pl. מִדְרָסוֹת cases of midras.
Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. II, 14 התקינו למנעול או למ׳ R. S. to Kel. XII, 5 (ed. למחרים, corr. acc.) if he made the nail for a shoe or a midras
